# HEIF fixtures

`opaque.heic` is the 64×64 generated HEVC still-image fixture from the
`heif-oxide` 0.1.0 test suite. It is distributed under that package's
MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms and contains no user metadata.

Koushi redistributes this asset under the MIT option: the upstream copyright and
permission notice is preserved verbatim at `LICENSE-MIT` next to this file, and
the asset is recorded in the repository's `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
